description:
FILED s473b (Opus, 2026-09-07) while shipping #1241, from that task's own
probe matrix.  PRE-EXISTING and unchanged by #1241 â measured before and
after on the same tree.

perl vivifies whenever an undefined value is DEREFERENCED, and a SINGLE-level
deref is a dereference too:

    { my $r; my $v = $r->{b};   print ref($r) }   perl HASH    PCL "" (undef)
    { my $r; my $v = $r->[0];   print ref($r) }   perl ARRAY   PCL ""
    { my $r; my $v = $$r{b};    print ref($r) }   perl HASH    PCL ""
    { my $r; my $v = ${$r}{b};  print ref($r) }   perl HASH    PCL ""
    { my $r; my $e = exists $r->{b}; print ref($r) }  perl HASH  PCL ""

(the `ref` PCL prints for an unmodified undef is itself wrong in one shape â
that is the separate #1349 â but `defined $r` says 0 in every row above, so
the finding does not depend on it.)

#1241 fixed the case where the container is ITSELF a subscripted place â
`$r->{p}{q}` vivifies `$r` and `$r->{p}` â because the emitter marks such a
container `p-viv-container` and the runtime's chain walker expands it.  A
single-level `$r->{b}` has no intermediate: its container is the bare scalar
`$r`, so nothing is marked and `p-gethash-deref`'s undef arm returns
`*p-undef*` without touching the ref.

FIX SHAPE, and it is small now that #1241 landed: `p-gethash-deref` /
`p-aref-deref` vivify their REF when it is undef, exactly as
`p-viv-ensure-hashref` already does for a chain root â that macro is the one
place the "vivify through the place, box or raw slot" rule is written down,
so the deref accessors should reach it rather than re-deriving it (rule 11).
The obstacle is that the accessors are FUNCTIONS and cannot see their
argument's place, so the emitter has to mark the ref the way it marks a
container: `gen_hash_ref_access_form` / `gen_array_ref_access_form` would wrap
a bare Symbol ref the way they already wrap an element one.

BAR when taken: this changes EVERY `$obj->{field}` read in the corpus (the
hottest shape there is), so it needs the emission A/B over the four
populations with every diff explained, the bench (`csvish`/`nested` rows of
s473b's scratch), the full sweep and the op/ companion leg â and the negative
probes: `f()->{b}` and `(EXPR)->{b}` are NOT places and must keep answering
undef without dying, and `my $v = $h{a}` must still create nothing.

RELATED: task #753 is the LVALUE half of the same seam (`${ $h{k} }[0] = 3`
writes nowhere because the deref base is not generated in lvalue context); its
note records an attempt that was backed out for want of a sweep leg.
subject: SILENT WRONG (pre-existing): a SINGLE-level deref read does not vivify its ref â `my $r; my $v = $r->{b};` leaves $r undef where perl makes it a hashref (#1241 fixed only the 2+-level chain)
